description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's diff and merge-base functionalities, including various scenarios with merge bases, ranges, and error conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with expected output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.
